BiblicalUsage: Shobeb means backsliding, and Jeremiah throws it at a daughter who will not come home. How long wilt thou go about, O thou backsliding daughter, and wherefore gloriest thou in thy valleys, trusting in thy treasures? Micah hears the same word in the lament of a spoiled people whose portion has been taken away.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe wandering is not freedom. The backsliding daughter went about looking for safety in her valleys and her treasures, and I hold that only the Lord who calls her home can give her rest.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
